name.en: National Teacher Certificate Examination (NTCE) registration photo
name.zh: 中小学教师资格考试报名照

notes.en: National registration-flow page: bareheaded, front-facing, colour, white background; JPG/JPEG; not larger than 200 KB. Pixel dimensions, print millimetres, DPI, minimum file size, and head ratio are not stated. Provincial announcements may add extra rules; this entry records only the national page.
notes.zh: 国家报名流程页：免冠、正面、彩色、白底；JPG/JPEG；不大于 200 KB。未写像素、印刷毫米、DPI、最小文件与头部比例。省级公告可能另有要求，本条只记国家页。
